about.title: Lemon Grove Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Lemon Grove is a small city, but its traffic isn't light — SR-94, Massachusetts Avenue, Lemon Grove Avenue, and Broadway all see a steady mix of commuters, local drivers, and cut-through traffic. Public records show 52 injury collisions and 78 injured people in the most recent full year, with crashes clustering on Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m., right when work traffic and weekend plans overlap. If you were hurt in one of these crashes, the days right after matter: insurers move fast, evidence disappears, and recorded statements can be used against you later. LawProactive doesn't practice law — we're a free service that connects injured people in Lemon Grove with an independent personal injury attorney who can evaluate what happened, deal with the insurance company, and explain your options under California law before you say something you can't take back.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Insurer Calls Again

items.title: Your Claim Has a Clock on It
items.desc: California generally gives you two years from the crash to file suit, but if a government vehicle or road defect was involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. An attorney can spot that issue early instead of letting it slip past.

items.title: Comparative Fault Cuts Both Ways
items.desc: California lets you recover damages even if you're partly at fault, but your share of blame reduces what you can collect. An independent attorney can push back on an insurer trying to pin more fault on you than the facts support.

items.title: No Fee Unless You Recover
items.desc: Attorneys in the network work on contingency, so there's no upfront cost to get an honest read on your Lemon Grove claim. You only pay if there's a recovery, which keeps the process free of pressure at the start.

items.question: Should I give the other driver's insurance company a recorded statement?
items.answer: It's best to hold off. Adjusters often ask leading questions designed to get you to downplay your injuries or accept partial blame, and once it's recorded, it's hard to walk back. Speaking with an attorney first helps you understand what you're required to say versus what can wait.

items.question: What if my crash happened near SR-94 or another Lemon Grove corridor with heavy traffic?
items.answer: Higher-traffic roads like SR-94, Massachusetts Avenue, and Broadway generate more collision reports simply because more vehicles use them, especially during Friday evening peaks. That doesn't change your legal rights — what matters is preserving the police report, photos, and witness details quickly before they're harder to track down.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, and the independent attorneys in the network take personal injury cases on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no fee for the initial conversation about your Lemon Grove accident.
